authors: Mehta, Vaibhav Pravinchandra; Sharma, Anuj; Van Hecke, Kristof; Van Meervelt, Luc; Van der Eycken, Erik
reference: A Novel and Versatile Entry to Asymmetrically Substituted Pyrazines | Mehta, Vaibhav Pravinchandra; Sharma, Anuj; Van Hecke, Kristof; Van Meervelt, Luc; Van der Eycken, Erik | Journal of Organic Chemistry (2008), 73(6), 2382-2388
experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: A Typical Procedure for the Suzuki Coupling To Generate Compound 5a-h. In a 10 mL microwave vial the following were successively dissolved in dioxane/H2O (1:1, 3 mL): halopyrazine 4a-c (0.3 mmol), boronic acid 6a-g (0.36 mmol, 1.2 equiv), Pd(PPh3)4 (8 mg, 2 mol %), and K2CO3 (84 mg, 2 equiv). The reaction tube was sealed and irradiated at a ceiling temperature of 120 °C using 150 W maximum power for 10 min. After the reaction mixture was cooled with an air flow for 15 min, extracted with dichloromethane (2 × 50 mL) and dried over MgSO4. The solvent was removed under reduced pressure, and the residue was subjected to preparative HPLC column chromatography. All the compounds were purified by reversed phase preparative HPLC using acetonitrile/ water (with 0.1% HCOOH) as the eluent. All gradients ran between 80:20:0.01 (water/acetonitrile/HCOOH) and 0:100:0.01 (water/acetonitrile/HCOOH) for 20 min, with the UV detector set at λ = 215 and 254 nm to afford compounds 5a-h. 3-methoxy-2-(methylthio)-5-p-tolylpyrazine (5b): 91% yield. yellow crystalline solid. m.p. 90-92 °C. 1H NMR (300 MHz, CDCl3): δ 8.43 (s, 1H), 7.88 (d, J = 8.9 Hz, 2H), 7.26 (d, J = 7.8 Hz, 2H), 4.11 (s, 3H), 2.57 (s, 3H), 2.40 (s, 3H). 13C NMR (75 MHz, CDCl3): δ 155.9, 144.5, 143.8, 139.1, 133.7, 132.1, 129.7, 126.2, 53.9, 21.4, 12.2. reference: Transition Metal-Catalyzed Orthogonal Solid-Phase Decoration of the 2(1H)-Pyrazinone Scaffold Using a Sulfur Linker | Kaval, Nadya; Singh, Brajendra Kumar; Ermolat'ev, Denis S.; Claerhout, Stijn; Parmar, Virinder S.; Van der Eycken, Johan; Van der Eycken, Erik | Journal of Combinatorial Chemistry (2007), 9(3), 446-453
experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: General Procedure for the Deprotection of the (p- Methoxy)benzyl Group at Position N1 of the Pyrazinone Ring on the Solid Support. A suspension of pyrazinone 20, obtained from 0.176 mmol of trityl protected resin 11, in a mixture of DCM-TFA (2:1, v/v) was irradiated at 120 °C for 40 min (hold time 2 min, maximum power 120 W). After the mixture was cooled to ambient temperature, the solvent was filtered off with a polypropylene frit cartridge, and the resin was washed with DCM (5 mL x 3), MeOH (5 mL x 3), and DCM (5 mL x 3). The resulting resin 21 was dried under vaccum. General Procedure of Chan-Lam Coupling of Pyrazinone 21 with Boronic Acids On Solid Support. Boronic acid (0.53 mmol, 3 equiv), Cu(OAc)2 (0.096 g, 0.53 mmol, 3 equiv), triethylamine (0.073 mL, 0.53 mmol, 3 equiv), and pyridine (0.087 mL, 1.06 mmol, 6 equiv) were added to a suspension of resin-bound pyrazinone 21, obtained starting from 0.176 mmol of trityl-protected resin 11, in DCM (3 mL). The reaction mixture was shaken at RT for 24 h in an ambient atmosphere; the solvent was then filtered off with a polypropylene frit cartridge, and the resin was washed with DCM (5 mL x 3), THF-(aq) NH3 (1:1, v/v, 5 mL x 3), THF-H2O (1:1, v/v, 5 mL x 3), THF (5 mL x 3), and DCM (5 mL x 3). The whole procedure was repeated once. The resulting resin-bound pyrazinone 22 was dried under vacuum. 3-Phenyl-5-chloro-1-(3-bromophenyl)-2(1H)-pyrazinone (55), yield (29%). mp: 132-133 °C (DCM-hexane). 1H NMR (CDCl3): δ 8.62 (s, 1H), 8.40 (m, 1H), 7.47-7.13 (m, 6H), 7.09 (m, 2H). 13C NMR (CDCl3): δ 153.2, 150.9, 148.0, 139.4, 130.6, 130.1, 129.8 (x2), 129.5, 128.6 (x2), 127.4, 126.5, 125.7, 122.4, 121.1. experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: General Procedure for the Synthesis of (4-Amino-2-arylthiazol-5-yl)(3,4,5-trimethoxyphenyl)methanone (3a-o). The reaction vessel was flushed with argon, then Pd2-dba3•CHCl3 (20 mg, 0.02 mmol) was added, and the reaction mixture was stirred at 70°C for 18 h. After cooling, the mixture was diluted with dichloromethane (5 mL) and filtered through Celite, and the filtrate was evaporated. experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: General Procedure for the Deprotection of the (p- Methoxy)benzyl Group at Position N1 of the Pyrazinone Ring on the Solid Support. A suspension of pyrazinone 20, obtained from 0.176 mmol of trityl protected resin 11, in a mixture of DCM-TFA (2:1, v/v) was irradiated at 120 °C for 40 min (hold time 2 min, maximum power 120 W). After the mixture was cooled to ambient temperature, the solvent was filtered off with a polypropylene frit cartridge, and the resin was washed with DCM (5 mL x 3), MeOH (5 mL x 3), and DCM (5 mL x 3). The resulting resin 21 was dried under vaccum. General Procedure of Chan-Lam Coupling of Pyrazinone 21 with Boronic Acids On Solid Support. Boronic acid (0.53 mmol, 3 equiv), Cu(OAc)2 (0.096 g, 0.53 mmol, 3 equiv), triethylamine (0.073 mL, 0.53 mmol, 3 equiv), and pyridine (0.087 mL, 1.06 mmol, 6 equiv) were added to a suspension of resin-bound pyrazinone 21, obtained starting from 0.176 mmol of trityl-protected resin 11, in DCM (3 mL). The reaction mixture was shaken at RT for 24 h in an ambient atmosphere; the solvent was then filtered off with a polypropylene frit cartridge, and the resin was washed with DCM (5 mL x 3), THF-(aq) NH3 (1:1, v/v, 5 mL x 3), THF-H2O (1:1, v/v, 5 mL x 3), THF (5 mL x 3), and DCM (5 mL x 3). experimental_procedure: A typical procedure for the arylation of 3 with arylboronic acids - Synthesis of 4-phenyl-4-p-tolyl-but-3-en-2-one (4g): Under nitrogen atmosphere, a mixture of 3aa (103 mg, 0.5 mmol), arylboronic acid 2d (102 mg, 0.75 mmol), Pd(PPh3)4 (43 mg, 0.0375 mmol), dppe (15 mg, 0.0375 mmol), CuTC (191 mg, 1.0 mmol) and K2CO3 (138 mg, 1.0 mmol) in 5 mL THF was stirred at 50°C for 13 h. experimental_procedure: General procedure (GP) for the syntheses of 3-12 (Liebeskind-Srogl Crosscoupling) BODIPY 3. An oven-dry round bottom flask, equipped with a stir bar, was charged with thiomethylbodipy 1 (40 mg, 0.168 mmol, 1 equiv), 4-(diphenylamino)phenylboronic acid (146 mg, 0.504 mmol, 3 equiv) and anhydrous THF (20 mL) under N2. The stirred solution was sparged with N2 for 10 min., whereupon Pd2dba3 (3.8 mg, 4.2 μmol, 2.5 mol%), tri(2-furyl)phosphine (2.9 mg, 12.6 μmol, 7.5 mol%) and copper(I) thiophene-2-carboxylate (96 mg, 0.504 mmol, 3 equiv) were added followed by 5 min N2-purge. An oven-dry Schlenk tube, equipped with a stir bar, was charged with the boronic acid (3 equiv.), thiomethyl bodipy 1 (1 equiv.) and dry THF (2 mL) under N2. The stirred solution was sparged with N2 for 10 min., whereupon CuTC (3 equiv.), Pd2(dba)3 (2.5 mol%), and TFP (7.5 mol%) were added under N2. The reaction mixture was immersed into a pre-heated oil bath at 55 °C. After TLC showed that the reaction went to completion, the reaction mixture was allowed to reach rt and was adsorbed on SiO2-gel. After flash-chromatography (SiO2-gel, EtOAc/hexanes gradient) purification, mesosubstituted bodipy's were obtained as highly-colored crystalline solids. reference: Regio- and Stereoselective Synthesis of Multisubstituted Olefins and Conjugate Dienes by Using α-Oxo Ketene Dithioacetals as the Building Blocks | Jin, Wei-Wei; Du, Wang-Ming; Yang, Qin; Yu, Hai-Feng; Chen, Ji-Ping; Yu, Zheng-Kun | Organic Letters (2011), 13(16), 4272-4275
experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: A typical procedure for the cross-coupling reactions of 1 with aryl- and alkenylboronic acids 2 - Synthesis of (E)-4-ethylsulfanyl-4-phenyl-but-3-en-2-one (3aa): Under nitrogen atmosphere, a mixture of α-oxo ketene dithioacetal 1a (95 mg, 0.5 mmol), arylboronic acid 2a (91 mg, 0.75 mmol), Pd(PPh3)4 (43 mg, 0.0375 mmol), CuTC (191 mg, 1.0 mmol) and Cs2CO3 (326 mg, 1.0 mmol) in 5 mL THF stirred at 50°C for 2 h. After cooled to ambient temperature, the resulting mixture was filtered through a short pad of celite and rinsed with 10 mL CH2Cl2. The combined filtrate was evaporated all the volatiles under reduced pressure. The resultant residue was purified by flash silica gel column chromatography (eluent : petroleum ether (60-90°C)/EtOAc = 30:1, v/v) to afford the product. HRMS Cacld for C13H16O2S: 236.0871; Found: 236.0873.

title: Simple, general, and efficient synthesis of meso-substituted borondipyrromethenes from a single platform
authors: Pena-Cabrera, Eduardo; Aguilar-Aguilar, Angelica; Gonzalez-Dominguez, Martha; Lager, Erik; Zamudio-Vazquez, Rubi; Godoy-Vargas, Jazmin; Villanueva-Garcia, Fabian
reference: Simple, general, and efficient synthesis of meso-substituted borondipyrromethenes from a single platform | Pena-Cabrera, Eduardo; Aguilar-Aguilar, Angelica; Gonzalez-Dominguez, Martha; Lager, Erik; Zamudio-Vazquez, Rubi; Godoy-Vargas, Jazmin; Villanueva-Garcia, Fabian | Organic Letters (2007), 9(20), 3985-3988
experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: Typical procedure (TP) for the cross-coupling of 1 with boronic acids. All of the reactions started with 0.06 mmol (15.0 mg) of thiomethylbodipy 1 as limiting reagent and the other components of the reaction were added in the amounts stated in the TP. An oven-dry Schlenk tube, equipped with a stir bar, was charged with the boronic acid (3 equiv.), thiomethyl bodipy 1 (1 equiv.) and dry THF (2 mL) under N2. The stirred solution was sparged with N2 for 10 min., whereupon CuTC (3 equiv.), Pd2(dba)3 (2.5 mol%), and TFP (7.5 mol%) were added under N2. The reaction mixture was immersed into a pre-heated oil bath at 55 °C. After TLC showed that the reaction went to completion, the reaction mixture was allowed to reach rt and was adsorbed on SiO2-gel. After flash-chromatography (SiO2-gel, EtOAc/hexanes gradient) purification, mesosubstituted bodipy's were obtained as highly-colored crystalline solids. For purposes of characterization, the products were crystallized from CH2Cl2/petroleum ether. BODIPY 18: According to TP. TLC (25% EtOAc/hexanes, R f = 0.35); orange crystals; mp 137-138 °C; yield= 81%; IR (KBr, cm-1): 3015 (m), 1602 (s), 1542 (s), 1411 (s), 1388 (s), 1259 (s), 1120 (s), 1077 (s). 1H NMR (200 MHz, CDCl3) δ 7.92 (s, 2H), 7.55 (dt, J 1= 8.8 Hz, J 2= 2.1 Hz, 2H), 7.05 (dt, J 1= 9.0 Hz, J 2= 2.2 Hz, 2H), 6.98 (d, J= 4.0 Hz, 2H), 6.56-6.54 (m, 2H), 3.92 (s, 3H); 13C NMR (50 MHz, CDCl3): δ 162.3, 147.7, 143.6, 135.1, 132.6, 131.6, 126.6, 118.4, 114.3, 55.7; HRMS (C16H13BF2N2O): calcd. 298.1089 found 298.1090.

experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: General Procedure for Synthesis of Derivatives 15 and 16. Boronic acid derivative (0.21 mmol), derivative 13a, 13c, or 14a,b (0.14 mmol), copper(I) thiophene-2-carboxylate (40.0 mg, 0.21 mmol), and Pd(PPh3)4 (23.1 mg, 0.02 mmol) were added to dioxane (3.0 mL) under inert atmosphere. The reaction was stirred at 90 °C. After 3.5 h, NaHCO3 saturated solution (10 mL) was added, and the resulting mixture was extracted with DCM (2 × 15 mL). Combined organic layers were washed with brine (15 mL), dried over Na2SO4, and filtered through Celite. experimental_procedure: A Typical Procedure for the Leibeskind-Srogl Coupling To Generate Compound 8a-e. In a 10 mL microwave vial the following were successively added: compound 5a-d, 5g (0.2 mmol), THF (3 mL), boronic acid 6a-d (0.6 mmol, 3.0 equiv), Pd(PPh3)4 (11 mg, 5 mol %), and CuTC (76 mg, 2 equiv). The reaction tube was sealed and irradiated at a ceiling temperature of 110 °C using 200 W maximum power for 50 min. After the reaction mixture was cooled with an air flow for 15 min, it was extracted with dichloromethane (2 × 50 mL) and dried over MgSO4. The compound was purified by reversed phase preparative HPLC using acetonitrile/water (with 0.1% HCOOH) as the eluent. All gradients ran between 80:20:0.01 (water/acetonitrile/HCOOH) and 0:100:0.01 (water/acetonitrile/HCOOH) for 25 min, with the UV detector set at λ = 215 and 254 nm to afford compound 8a-e. 2-(3-Ethoxyphenyl)-3-methoxy-5-(4-methoxyphenyl)pyrazine (8a): 82% yield. experimental_procedure: General procedure 1: To a stirred mixture of 5,17-bis(methylsulfanyl)oxacalix[2]arene[2]pyrimidine 1 (100 mg, 0.20 mmol) and Pd(PPh3)4 (12 mg, 5 mol%) in THF (5 mL) under Ar, the respective arylboronic acid 2a–d (0.61 mmol, 3 equiv) and CuTC (139 mg, 0.71 mmol, 3.5 equiv) were added, and the resulting mixture was heated at reflux for 24 h under an Ar atmosphere. experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: General Procedure for Liebeskind-Srogl Cross-Coupling Reaction on Derivative 10a at C-8. To a mixture of 2-phenyl-4-diethylamino-8-methylsulfanylpyrido[3,2-d]pyrimidine-6-carboxylic acid methyl ester 10a (54 mg, 0.14 mmol), a boronic acid (0.14 mmol), copper(I) thiophene-2-carboxylate (27 mg, 0.14 mmol), and Pd(PPh3)4 (8 mg, 0.007 mmol) was added dioxane (3.0 mL) under inert atmosphere. The reaction was stirred at 90 °C and monitored by LCMS. After 3.5 h, a saturated solution of NaHCO3 (10 mL) was added, and the desired product was extracted with DCM (3 × 10 mL). Combined organic layers were washed with brine (10 mL), dried over Na2SO4, and filtered on Celite. After evaporation of the solvents, the resulting solid was triturated in MeOH, filtered and dried under vacuum to afford derivatives 11a to 11c. 2-Phenyl-4-diethylamino-8-(4-methoxyphenyl)pyrido[3,2-d]pyrimidine-6-carboxylic acid methyl ester (11b): yield = 88%; yellow solid; Mp 165-166 °C; IR νmax 1715, 1511, 1242 cm-1; 1H NMR (300 MHz, CDCl3) δ 1.30-1.65 (br m, 6H), 3.80-4.20 (br m, 2H), 3.93 (s, 3H), 4.02 (s, 3H), 4.20-4.60 (br m, 2H), 7.10 (d, J= 8 Hz, 2H), 7.47 (m, 3H), 7.92 (d, J= 8 Hz, 2H), 8.36 (s, 1H), 8.47- 8.49 (m, 2H); 13C NMR (75.47 MHz, CDCl3) δ 13.7, 14.3, 46.6, 52.7, 55.4, 113.6, 125.9, 128.2, 128.8, 129.0, 130.4, 132.2, 133.0, 138.7, 142.4, 146.3, 147.1, 159.3, 160.2, 160.7, 165.7; HPLC tR = 4.93 min; ES-MS m/z 443.09 (M + H)+. authors: Bouscary-Desforges, Gwenaelle; Bombrun, Agnes; Augustine, John Kallikat; Bernardinelli, Gerald; Quattropani, Anna
reference: Regioselective Synthesis of 2,8-Disubstituted 4-Aminopyrido[3,2-d]pyrimidine-6-carboxylic Acid Methyl Ester Compounds | Bouscary-Desforges, Gwenaelle; Bombrun, Agnes; Augustine, John Kallikat; Bernardinelli, Gerald; Quattropani, Anna | Journal of Organic Chemistry (2012), 77(1), 243-252
experimental_procedure: General Procedure for Liebeskind-Srogl Cross-Coupling Reaction on Derivative 10a at C-8. To a mixture of 2-phenyl-4-diethylamino-8-methylsulfanylpyrido[3,2-d]pyrimidine-6-carboxylic acid methyl ester 10a (54 mg, 0.14 mmol), a boronic acid (0.14 mmol), copper(I) thiophene-2-carboxylate (27 mg, 0.14 mmol), and Pd(PPh3)4 (8 mg, 0.007 mmol) was added dioxane (3.0 mL) under inert atmosphere. The reaction was stirred at 90 °C and monitored by LCMS. After 3.5 h, a saturated solution of NaHCO3 (10 mL) was added, and the desired product was extracted with DCM (3 × 10 mL). authors: Kaval, Nadya; Singh, Brajendra Kumar; Ermolat'ev, Denis S.; Claerhout, Stijn; Parmar, Virinder S.; Van der Eycken, Johan; Van der Eycken, Erik
reference: Transition Metal-Catalyzed Orthogonal Solid-Phase Decoration of the 2(1H)-Pyrazinone Scaffold Using a Sulfur Linker | Kaval, Nadya; Singh, Brajendra Kumar; Ermolat'ev, Denis S.; Claerhout, Stijn; Parmar, Virinder S.; Van der Eycken, Johan; Van der Eycken, Erik | Journal of Combinatorial Chemistry (2007), 9(3), 446-453
experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: General Procedure for the Deprotection of the (p- Methoxy)benzyl Group at Position N1 of the Pyrazinone Ring on the Solid Support. A suspension of pyrazinone 20, obtained from 0.176 mmol of trityl protected resin 11, in a mixture of DCM-TFA (2:1, v/v) was irradiated at 120 °C for 40 min (hold time 2 min, maximum power 120 W). After the mixture was cooled to ambient temperature, the solvent was filtered off with a polypropylene frit cartridge, and the resin was washed with DCM (5 mL x 3), MeOH (5 mL x 3), and DCM (5 mL x 3). The resulting resin 21 was dried under vaccum. General Procedure of Chan-Lam Coupling of Pyrazinone 21 with Boronic Acids On Solid Support. Boronic acid (0.53 mmol, 3 equiv), Cu(OAc)2 (0.096 g, 0.53 mmol, 3 equiv), triethylamine (0.073 mL, 0.53 mmol, 3 equiv), and pyridine (0.087 mL, 1.06 mmol, 6 equiv) were added to a suspension of resin-bound pyrazinone 21, obtained starting from 0.176 mmol of trityl-protected resin 11, in DCM (3 mL). The reaction mixture was shaken at RT for 24 h in an ambient atmosphere; the solvent was then filtered off with a polypropylene frit cartridge, and the resin was washed with DCM (5 mL x 3), THF-(aq) NH3 (1:1, v/v, 5 mL x 3), THF-H2O (1:1, v/v, 5 mL x 3), THF (5 mL x 3), and DCM (5 mL x 3). The whole procedure was repeated once. The resulting resin-bound pyrazinone 22 was dried under vacuum. 3-(3-Chlorophenyl)-5-chloro-1-(3-trifluromethylphenyl)- 2(1H)-pyrazinone(25), yield (29%). mp: 100-101 °C (DCM-hexane). 1H NMR (CDCl3): δ 8.4 (s, 1H), 8.33-8.30 (d, J = 8.2 Hz, 1H), 7.71-7.67 (m, 4H), 7.48-7.41 (m, 3H), 7.30 (s, 1H). 13C NMR (CDCl3): 153.9, 152.0, 139.5, 136.4, 134.7, 133.0, 132.5, 131.5, 130.8, 129.9, 129.6, 127.9, 127.3, 126.8, 125.3, 123.5, 121.7. HRMS (EI) Calcd for C17H9Cl2F3N2O: 384.0040. Found: 384.0037.

To a suspension of 2- benzylamino-8-chloro-4-dimethylaminopyrido[3,2-d]pyrimidine-6-carboxylic acid methyl ester 3b (112 mg, 0.30 mmol) and a boronic acid (1.50 mmol) in dioxane (2.0 mL) were added Cs2CO3 (293 mg, 0.90 mmol) and Pd(PPh3)4 (17.3 mg, 0.015 mmol) under inert atmosphere. experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: A Typical Procedure for the Suzuki Coupling To Generate Compound 5a-h. In a 10 mL microwave vial the following were successively dissolved in dioxane/H2O (1:1, 3 mL): halopyrazine 4a-c (0.3 mmol), boronic acid 6a-g (0.36 mmol, 1.2 equiv), Pd(PPh3)4 (8 mg, 2 mol %), and K2CO3 (84 mg, 2 equiv). The reaction tube was sealed and irradiated at a ceiling temperature of 120 °C using 150 W maximum power for 10 min. After the reaction mixture was cooled with an air flow for 15 min, extracted with dichloromethane (2 × 50 mL) and dried over MgSO4. The solvent was removed under reduced pressure, and the residue was subjected to preparative HPLC column chromatography. All the compounds were purified by reversed phase preparative HPLC using acetonitrile/ water (with 0.1% HCOOH) as the eluent. experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: General Procedure for the Deprotection of the (p- Methoxy)benzyl Group at Position N1 of the Pyrazinone Ring on the Solid Support. A suspension of pyrazinone 20, obtained from 0.176 mmol of trityl protected resin 11, in a mixture of DCM-TFA (2:1, v/v) was irradiated at 120 °C for 40 min (hold time 2 min, maximum power 120 W). After the mixture was cooled to ambient temperature, the solvent was filtered off with a polypropylene frit cartridge, and the resin was washed with DCM (5 mL x 3), MeOH (5 mL x 3), and DCM (5 mL x 3). The resulting resin 21 was dried under vaccum. General Procedure of Chan-Lam Coupling of Pyrazinone 21 with Boronic Acids On Solid Support. experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: General Procedure for Synthesis of Derivatives 10. authors: Mehta, Vaibhav Pravinchandra; Sharma, Anuj; Van Hecke, Kristof; Van Meervelt, Luc; Van der Eycken, Erik
reference: A Novel and Versatile Entry to Asymmetrically Substituted Pyrazines | Mehta, Vaibhav Pravinchandra; Sharma, Anuj; Van Hecke, Kristof; Van Meervelt, Luc; Van der Eycken, Erik | Journal of Organic Chemistry (2008), 73(6), 2382-2388
experimental_procedure: A Typical Procedure for the Suzuki Coupling To Generate Compound 5a-h. In a 10 mL microwave vial the following were successively dissolved in dioxane/H2O (1:1, 3 mL): halopyrazine 4a-c (0.3 mmol), boronic acid 6a-g (0.36 mmol, 1.2 equiv), Pd(PPh3)4 (8 mg, 2 mol %), and K2CO3 (84 mg, 2 equiv). The reaction tube was sealed and irradiated at a ceiling temperature of 120 °C using 150 W maximum power for 10 min. After the reaction mixture was cooled with an air flow for 15 min, extracted with dichloromethane (2 × 50 mL) and dried over MgSO4. The solvent was removed under reduced pressure, and the residue was subjected to preparative HPLC column chromatography. All the compounds were purified by reversed phase preparative HPLC using acetonitrile/ water (with 0.1% HCOOH) as the eluent. All gradients ran between 80:20:0.01 (water/acetonitrile/HCOOH) and 0:100:0.01 (water/acetonitrile/HCOOH) for 20 min, with the UV detector set at λ = 215 and 254 nm to afford compounds 5a-h. 3-Methoxy-5-(4-methoxyphenyl)-2-(methylthio)pyrazine (5a): 92% yield. white crystalline solid. reference: Transition Metal-Catalyzed Orthogonal Solid-Phase Decoration of the 2(1H)-Pyrazinone Scaffold Using a Sulfur Linker | Kaval, Nadya; Singh, Brajendra Kumar; Ermolat'ev, Denis S.; Claerhout, Stijn; Parmar, Virinder S.; Van der Eycken, Johan; Van der Eycken, Erik | Journal of Combinatorial Chemistry (2007), 9(3), 446-453
experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: General Procedure for the Deprotection of the (p- Methoxy)benzyl Group at Position N1 of the Pyrazinone Ring on the Solid Support. A suspension of pyrazinone 20, obtained from 0.176 mmol of trityl protected resin 11, in a mixture of DCM-TFA (2:1, v/v) was irradiated at 120 °C for 40 min (hold time 2 min, maximum power 120 W). After the mixture was cooled to ambient temperature, the solvent was filtered off with a polypropylene frit cartridge, and the resin was washed with DCM (5 mL x 3), MeOH (5 mL x 3), and DCM (5 mL x 3). The resulting resin 21 was dried under vaccum. General Procedure of Chan-Lam Coupling of Pyrazinone 21 with Boronic Acids On Solid Support. Boronic acid (0.53 mmol, 3 equiv), Cu(OAc)2 (0.096 g, 0.53 mmol, 3 equiv), triethylamine (0.073 mL, 0.53 mmol, 3 equiv), and pyridine (0.087 mL, 1.06 mmol, 6 equiv) were added to a suspension of resin-bound pyrazinone 21, obtained starting from 0.176 mmol of trityl-protected resin 11, in DCM (3 mL). The reaction mixture was shaken at RT for 24 h in an ambient atmosphere; the solvent was then filtered off with a polypropylene frit cartridge, and the resin was washed with DCM (5 mL x 3), THF-(aq) NH3 (1:1, v/v, 5 mL x 3), THF-H2O (1:1, v/v, 5 mL x 3), THF (5 mL x 3), and DCM (5 mL x 3). The whole procedure was repeated once. The resulting resin-bound pyrazinone 22 was dried under vacuum. 3-(3-Bromophenyl)-5-chloro-1-(4-methoxyphenyl)-2(1H)- pyrazinone (54), yield (35%). mp: 171-172 °C (DCM-hexane). 1H NMR (CDCl3): δ 8.63 (s, 1H), 8.37 (d, 2H, J = 8.9 Hz), 7.55-7.40 (3H), 7.12 (m, 3H), 3.79 (s, 3H). 13C NMR (CDCl3): δ 160.1, 153.4, 153.0, 150.7, 138.1, 132.8, 131.5, 130.3, 129.1, 128.7, 128.3, 127.6 (x2), 125.3, 124.2, 112.3 (x2), 55.7. HRMS (EI) Cacd for C17H12N2O2BrCl: 389.9771. Found: 389.9767.

reference: Transition Metal-Catalyzed Orthogonal Solid-Phase Decoration of the 2(1H)-Pyrazinone Scaffold Using a Sulfur Linker | Kaval, Nadya; Singh, Brajendra Kumar; Ermolat'ev, Denis S.; Claerhout, Stijn; Parmar, Virinder S.; Van der Eycken, Johan; Van der Eycken, Erik | Journal of Combinatorial Chemistry (2007), 9(3), 446-453
experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: General Procedure for the Deprotection of the (p- Methoxy)benzyl Group at Position N1 of the Pyrazinone Ring on the Solid Support. A suspension of pyrazinone 20, obtained from 0.176 mmol of trityl protected resin 11, in a mixture of DCM-TFA (2:1, v/v) was irradiated at 120 °C for 40 min (hold time 2 min, maximum power 120 W). After the mixture was cooled to ambient temperature, the solvent was filtered off with a polypropylene frit cartridge, and the resin was washed with DCM (5 mL x 3), MeOH (5 mL x 3), and DCM (5 mL x 3). The resulting resin 21 was dried under vaccum. General Procedure of Chan-Lam Coupling of Pyrazinone 21 with Boronic Acids On Solid Support. Boronic acid (0.53 mmol, 3 equiv), Cu(OAc)2 (0.096 g, 0.53 mmol, 3 equiv), triethylamine (0.073 mL, 0.53 mmol, 3 equiv), and pyridine (0.087 mL, 1.06 mmol, 6 equiv) were added to a suspension of resin-bound pyrazinone 21, obtained starting from 0.176 mmol of trityl-protected resin 11, in DCM (3 mL). The reaction mixture was shaken at RT for 24 h in an ambient atmosphere; the solvent was then filtered off with a polypropylene frit cartridge, and the resin was washed with DCM (5 mL x 3), THF-(aq) NH3 (1:1, v/v, 5 mL x 3), THF-H2O (1:1, v/v, 5 mL x 3), THF (5 mL x 3), and DCM (5 mL x 3). The whole procedure was repeated once. The resulting resin-bound pyrazinone 22 was dried under vacuum. 3-(3-Trifluromethylphenyl)-5-chloro-1-(3-ethoxyphenyl)- 2(1H)-pyrazinone (43), yield (32%). mp: 90-91 °C (DCM-hexane). 1H NMR (CDCl3): δ 8.46-8.42 (d, J = 9.12 Hz, 1H), 7.45-7.33 (m, 3H), 7.16-7.12 (m, 1H), 7.07-6.94 (m, 4H), 4.08-4.01 (q, J = 7.3 Hz, 2H,), 1.43-1.39 (t, J = 7.3 Hz, 3H). 13C NMR (CDCl3): δ 159.7, 156.1, 153.9, 152.1, 140.0, 135.0, 131.3, 130.4, 129.8, 129.5, 129.2, 126.4, 125.2, 123.9, 119.6, 117.6, 117.4, 115.7, 112.2, 63.9, 14.6. experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: 2-Aryl-5-chloropyrazines 9a-j; General Procedure A mixture of pyrazine 5 (0.5 mmol), boronic acid 8 (2 equiv), Pd(PPh3)4 (5 mol%) and CuTC (1.5 equiv) in THF (4 mL) was irradiated in a 15-mL sealed tube at a ceiling temperature of 120 °C using 500-W maximum power for 30 minutes. After 30 min more of the above reactants, boronic acid 8 (1 equiv), Pd(PPh3)4 (5 mol%) and CuTC (1 equiv) were added and the reaction was run for a further 30 min under the same conditions. After completion of the reaction, the mixture was filtered through celite and the filtrate was diluted with EtOAc (200 mL) and washed with H2O (100 mL) and brine (100 mL). The organic layerwas dried (MgSO4) and the solvent was removed under reduced pressure and the residue was purified by column chromatography (silica gel, 0-30% EtOAc-heptane) to afford compounds 9a-j. 5-Chloro-3-methoxy-2-(4-methoxyphenyl)pyrazine (9a) The reaction was carried out on a 5 mmol scale. 2-Chlor6-5-(3,4-dimethoxyphenyl)-6-methoxy-3-methylpyrazine (9f) The reaction was carried out on a 5 mmol scale. Light-yellow solid; yield: 1.37 g (4.65 mmol, 93%). mp 94—96 °C. 1HNMR (300 MHz, CDCl3): δ = 7.72 (d, J = 8.46 Hz, 1H), 7.65 (d, J = 1.14 Hz, 1 H), 6.94 (d, J=8.46 Hz, 1 H), 4.03 (s, 3 H), 3.96 (s, 3 H), 3.93 (s, 3 H), 2.61 (s, 3 H). 13CNMR (75 MHz, CDCl3): δ = 154.9, 150.0, 148.7, 142.1, 139.4, 129.6, 127.6, 122.2, 113.8, 111.9, 110.5, 55.9 (2 C), 54.4, 20.7. HRMS (EI): m/z [M] calcd for C14H15ClN2O3: 294.0771; found: 294.0765.
notes: microwave irradiation, sealed tube used, Liebeskind-Srogl coupling
